description: Use when a restaurant owner asks what is normal for restaurant phone calls: how many calls a day, when calls come in (busiest hours, dayparts and weekdays), how many arrive after hours, what share are orders, and the typical phone order value. Returns Maple's published benchmarks with the window and spread (middle half) of each figure. It does not state how many restaurants, calls or orders sit behind them. The data covers calls Maple answered for its own restaurant customers, not all restaurants, and has no missed-call rate. Read-only.
name: get_call_benchmarks
title: Restaurant phone call benchmarks
